definitions.explanation: Something made or created by oneself. Used for anything from computers built from parts, to poems or songs one has written, to food one has grown. Emphasizes that the creator and the user/owner are the same person.

examples.japanese: {自作|じさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I'm using a computer I built myself.

examples.japanese: {自作|じさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I posted a song I wrote myself online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自作|じさく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: The shelf my friend built himself is sturdier than store-bought ones.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({自作|じさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧) or as a suru-verb ({自作|じさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to make/build oneself). Very common in hobbies and tech culture: {自作|じさく}PC (DIY/custom-built PC) is a major hobby in Japan.

Compared to ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ (handmade), {自作|じさく} emphasizes that you made it yourself (self as creator), while ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ emphasizes the handcrafted method. Compared to ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧ (homemade, house-made), {自作|じさく} focuses on personal creation while ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧ focuses on being made at home or in-house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自作|じさく}PC: custom-built PC
- {自作|じさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: a song one wrote
- {自作|じさく}{自演|じえん}: staging one's own work (also: creating a problem and pretending to solve it)
- {自作|じさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: vegetables one grew oneself
